sub_indicators.label: Long-distance fibre across the country
sub_indicators.subject: infra.connect
sub_indicators.text: National fibre backbone: long-distance fibre across the country
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy and its Programme for Infrastructure Development in Africa ask each state to build a national backbone that reaches every region and to share it among operators.
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country has no national fibre backbone, and nothing later says one is being built.
In the past three years a national fibre backbone has been put under contract or works have begun. A plan, a study, a tender or money promised does not count.
Backbone fibre is in service between the capital and at least one other region, whoever owns it: the state, a utility or an operator.
A source states that the backbone reaches every province or region.
The backbone reaches every province or region, and other operators buy capacity on it, or it runs on open-access or wholesale terms.

aspects.name: Built, in service and reaching every region
